fields.label: Employee
fields.description: Who this phone belongs to. It can never be changed: the record of who punched has to stay true.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Active
Blocked
Replaced
Removed
Consent not given
Signed out
fields.description: Only an Active phone may send a check-in. Every other state is refused with its own reason. Blocked, Replaced and Removed are final - getting the app back always needs a new code. A phone that is linked but has not agreed to the notice sits in Consent not given and cannot punch. Signed out is a phone that signed in with a password that has since changed: its secret is retired, and the person signs in again with the new password (the record then ends Replaced).

fields.label: Device
fields.description: What the phone reported about itself at registration. A hint for HR, never trusted as proof.

fields.label: How it joined
fields.options:
Web check-in page
App QR code
App password sign-in
fields.description: Set by the server when the phone joined. Empty means it joined on the web check-in page before this was recorded.

fields.label: App code
fields.description: The code that let this phone in - and so the HR decision behind it. Set by the server at join, never changed.

fields.label: App version
fields.description: The app build on this phone, as sent at join and on each saved punch. Never updated by merely opening the app.

fields.label: Token Hash
fields.description: SHA-256 of the device secret. The secret itself is shown once, to the phone, and never stored.

fields.label: Retired Token Hash
fields.description: The secret's hash, moved here when the phone stopped. Keeps "why did this phone stop working" answerable while the live hash is empty.

fields.label: Password Stamp
fields.description: A keyed fingerprint (HMAC) of the login's password hash when this phone signed in with a password. Never the password or the hash. When the login's password changes, the fingerprint no longer matches and the phone is signed out. Permission level 1, which no role holds, so it is never sent to a browser.

fields.label: Status changed on
fields.description: When the status last moved. `modified` also moves when anything else is saved.

fields.label: Status changed by
fields.description: Empty when the employee or the system changed it.

fields.label: Why it was blocked
fields.options:
Phone lost or stolen
Has a new phone
Someone else was using it
Left the company
Login disabled
Login unlinked
Other
fields.description: Required whenever a phone is blocked. Kept in the record. It is never sent to the phone or shown to the employee.

fields.label: Replaced by
fields.description: The phone that took over from this one. Set by the server only.

fields.label: Last punch
fields.description: The last time this phone recorded a check-in. It does not move when the app is merely opened.

fields.label: Notice Accepted On
fields.description: When the employee ticked that they had read the notice on this phone.

fields.label: Notice Version
fields.description: Which version of the notice they saw. Changes whenever the notice's meaning changes.
